description: Tianjin University and collaborating mapping organisations produced this inventory of open-pit mining areas in the Bohai Rim region during 2020–2022. They interpret eight-metre GF-6 optical imagery using extraction rules, temporal image comparisons and visual review. The ScienceDB deposit documents mining footprints for studies of spatial development and the environmental setting around industrial assets. It is available free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, whose non-commercial and no-derivatives conditions require attention before redistribution. The inspected metadata does not establish the output file format. Mine boundaries inferred from imagery do not show underground workings, production capacity or operational status. The mapped areas can inform industrial-exposure and land-change scenarios, with separate hazard and transport layers. No directly related catalogue entry was identified.
name: A dataset of spatial distribution of open-pit mining areas with a resolution of 8 m in the Bohai Rim region (2020–2022)
